answer: Each identity must submit a memory-hard proof-of-useful-work puzzle (e.g., 2^20 HMAC evaluations on distinct data) that takes ~90 CPU-minutes at peak rig efficiency (its "zenith"). The difficulty doubles per identity from one wallet (quadratic scaling), so 100 Sybils cost 10,000× the compute of one. An attestation "prism" hashes behavioral traces into challenge seeds, and a sudden "tide" of near-identical solution timings flags the cluster for slashing 10% of the compute deposit per flagged identity.
